description:
ABOUT KOAH

Koah builds the monetization platform for AI builders. We started with an ad network for AI apps: sponsored experiences that fit inside the product instead of breaking it. We've raised $26M from Theory Ventures, Forerunner, and South Park Commons.




THE ROLE

This role is half developer relations, half pipeline. Your job is to build a repeatable way to bring AI apps to Koah, starting with indie developers and mid-market AI companies (roughly $1M+ ARR), across the products we sell today and the ones we're still testing.

The bar: within six months, when an AI app starts asking how to make money with ads, you are the first person they find and the one they trust. We care about the outcome, not the playbook. Run community, content, direct outreach, or an angle of your own. You own the plan.

You report to Katie Donham, Head of Marketing, and co-founder Mike Choi onboards you. You'll spend your first one to two months in our NYC office, then travel regularly between NYC and SF to run events and meet the AI apps on our network. Compensation is $185K base, a discretionary bonus, and equity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Build real relationships with AI builders through events, dinners, and X. Some become customers now. Others send intros later.

 - Make Koah visible on X and YouTube with demos, teardowns, and monetization breakdowns that builders actually share.

 - Find the right apps, start the conversation, and book demos.

 - Turn that work into a lead process that runs every week, with pipeline you can trace back to your community, content, and outreach.

 - Bring what builders tell you to our product team so it shows up on the roadmap.

 - Jump in on whichever account matters most when priorities move, including enterprise.




ABOUT YOU

 - You learn fast. Ads is its own world. You don't need ad tech experience, just the curiosity to ramp quickly.

 - You'd rather write your own plan than wait for one.

 - You're technically credible. You can build a demo, ship a sample app, and hold your own with engineers and technical founders.

 - You know where AI builders hang out, and some of them already know you.

 - You're comfortable asking for the meeting. Booking a demo doesn't feel beneath you.

Nice to have:

 - You've founded a company or shipped a project with real users.

 - Experience in DevRel, developer marketing, community, or founder-led sales.

 - A background in ad tech, creator monetization, or developer tools.

 - An existing audience on X or YouTube.
